summary: As a bounded explanation of why one AI answer fails and how to repair it, this opening is craftsmanlike: mechanism-led, jargon-safe, honest about limits, and warm. But measured against the supplied reader job it opens on the wrong footing: it is a system-map, component-diagnosis introduction that delivers only the first of the three required reader transformations. Judging hype or panic in public claims and informed participation in workplace and public decisions are never motivated before the technical machinery begins, the single worked example occupies the whole opening, and the broader payoffs are gestured at only through a future chapter list. The candidate repair is a purpose-led opening establishing all three transformations before the system walkthrough, not a rewrite of the otherwise strong Chapter 1 mechanics.
strengths: The job-offer worked example has genuine human stakes (Tuesday physiotherapy, income anxiety) and is followed faithfully from weak input to repaired output.
Technical terms are defined exactly where they do causal work, so the reader never carries unexplained jargon.
Limits and boundaries are honestly retained: the revised answer is framed as a better comparison, not objective truth, and non-delegable judgments are named.
The repair pattern and four closing questions give concrete, reusable diagnostic actions rather than generic caution.
